answer.rationale: The strongest signal is temporal: write-path p99 began degrading after the release and is now 5x target during settlement peak. I am verifying memory_b1 because it is the only inherited record that rollback restored stability without customer impact; b6 supports using guarded release mechanics rather than an uncontrolled broad action. Because this is the write path at daily settlement peak, I flag value-loss risk and would only roll back in a guarded/draining manner that preserves accepted writes; if verification shows rollback is unsafe for write compatibility, capacity would be the fallback next window rather than risking settlement loss.
